notes: Top bar auto-hide, Windhawk-style: the hidden top bar now appears reliably when the mouse touches the top edge. Two causes fixed — a maximized window's top edge was negative (the window rect bleeds past the monitor), so the reveal could never trigger, and the show zone was only 2 pixels. The reveal now uses the work-area top for maximized windows and a 6-pixel show zone. Verified here: 281 automated tests passing, zero clippy warnings on Linux and Windows targets, frontend build clean, Windows installer cross-built and signed on Linux (real-PC test still the gate).
